name: sftp-push-sync-monorepo
description: Monorepo for sftp-push-sync: core sync engine, CLI and Electron GUI

scripts.release:mac: npm run dist:mac-arm -w @sftp-push-sync/gui && node scripts/stage-release.mjs --platform=macos && node scripts/transport-release.mjs --platform=macos
scripts.cli-release:patch: npm run build:noop -w packages/cli && npm version patch -w packages/cli && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --access public -w packages/cli
scripts.cli-release:minor: npm run build:noop -w packages/cli && npm version minor -w packages/cli && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --access public -w packages/cli
scripts.cli-release:major: npm run build:noop -w packages/cli && npm version major -w packages/cli && git push && git push --tags && npm publish --access public -w packages/cli

author: Carsten Nichte
